name: Sidestep Charge (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at dodging charging opponents and taking advantage when they miss.

Prerequisite: Dodge.

Benefit: You gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against charge attacks. If a charging opponent fails to make a successful attack against you, you gain an immediate attack of opportunity. This feat does not grant you more attacks of opportunity than you are normally allowed in a round.

If you are flat-footed or otherwise denied your Dexterity bonus to AC, you do not gain the benefit of this feat.
